text: i see. i think the verb usage is wrong tbh. or at least its in the wrong level of hierarchy because none of these says its a core story mission or not
resolution: Design exchange folded into req_0914: established that the activities 'verb' (role/rob/chase/evade/race/jump/accumulate) is the gameplay-flavor / distribution-preset axis and is orthogonal to a mission's narrative tier — nothing in MissionDef states 'core story vs side/daily'. Surfaced that the doctrine already implies tiers (opening-arc=main, seed=daily, binding=contract, delivery-gig=tutorial) but never as a first-class field. User resolved the direction: rather than a new 'track' enum, they want their original quest-object shape (title/id/author/questline/fromNPC/desc/reward/dependents/constraints/events) made comprehensive, with questline as the organizing field. No code in this req; the build lands under req_0914.
